why: RED-expected spec: a report-slot worker that honestly cites nothing must pass without an anchor rejection. Today report_anchors.scan counts the harness's own appended inspect link (.graff/subagents/<id>.md, leading dot trimmed so it never resolves) as a fabricated citation, so every citation-free report is auto-rejected and burns the phase retry. Goes green when the scan excludes the harness-appended suffix (or resolves dotted paths).
